A Name Rooted in Love & Legacy

Cilla Skyn™ was created from a deeply personal place, one rooted in love, care and intention.

The name Cilla comes from Priscilla, my mother and the inspiration at the heart of the brand. Her strength, warmth and presence inspired a name that carries something deeply personal, while reflecting the values we want every Cilla Skyn™ product to embody.

What began as a personal inspiration evolved into a vision for skincare that feels both meaningful and modern. A vision centred on thoughtfully selected ingredients, elevated textures and a genuine respect for the skin.

Cilla Skyn™ represents a modern expression of African skincare, celebrating the richness of our botanical heritage while embracing the possibilities of contemporary cosmetic science.

Every formula is created with intention, bringing together nature, science and sensorial experience to transform everyday skincare into a ritual that feels considered, comforting and beautifully your own.

CILLA SKYN™ is pronounced SILL-UH SKIN.
